owner_priority: Deliver a stable, supported and fully updated public OS release with its own project branding, recoverable installation and measured hardware/security acceptance. Connect and feature QA follow platform release readiness; no app QA on the interim donor ROM.

tasks.name: Ordered roadmap and issue-to-PR workflow
tasks.goal: Make this roadmap and Project4 the single ordered delivery contract.
steps: Inventory existing scopes and split combined hardware tasks without duplicating them.
Record native parent links, order, dependencies, done criteria and primary PRs.
Read back the board and validate this manifest; update the recurring workflow.
tasks.acceptance: All14 hardware groups have dedicated issues, native hierarchy and visible order/dependency/gate/PR fields; roadmap PR and checks pass.

tasks.name: Finish already-open PWM source PR436
tasks.goal: Finish the source change opened before the roadmap correction; no new PWM scope.
steps: Verify exact-head488 tests and Linux PWM object/config/final Image hashes.
Match PR436 to this dedicated source task.
Merge only all required exact-head checks pass; park private binding work.
tasks.acceptance: PR436 exact-head source/native/preflight/object/config/Image acceptance passes; no hardware/DT/binding pass is claimed.

tasks.name: First-boot entry and go/no-go decision
tasks.goal: Resolve the actual barrier to a first recoverable diagnostic boot.
steps: Use existing exact PL7/LK3/TEE262 route evidence; do not repeat source microtraces or completed stock captures.
Choose one reviewed operational route or identify why none is currently safe/applicable.
Specify exact minimal package, entry/memory/CPU/transport contract, recovery/log/power/thermal pretrial conditions and stop criteria.
Present one concrete next action/owner decision, with explicit approval if high brick risk.
tasks.acceptance: Reviewable GO/NO-GO decision and single next action. NO-GO can finish this decision task but never unblocks physical entry or closes recovery/log gates.

tasks.name: Board inspection — not needed for selected software route
tasks.goal: Prepare an exact-board inspection/isolation plan only if the route decision selects it.
steps: Reuse completed owner/stock evidence; no repeat generic photo/cable request.
Specify exact target, tools, isolation, electrical risks and independent return limits.
Obtain any required approval before physical/electrical action.
tasks.acceptance: Concrete exact-generation proposal is reviewable; physical entry/electrical/log gates stay unqualified until tested.
conditions: Only selected if the admission decision makes this a necessary prerequisite; not an unrelated task bypass.
tasks.disposition_reason: Case-closed approved software route reached TWRP and Android11 without opening or a short; conditional inspection branch not selected. No physical-inspection pass claimed.

tasks.name: Qualified current-device entry and bounded trial
tasks.goal: Demonstrate the selected diagnostic entry under a reviewed recoverable plan.
steps: Require GO, exact artifact/hash/CPU/memory/transport contract and all pretrial safety/log/recovery conditions.
Obtain explicit approval for any high-brick-risk route; standing low-risk permission is not unlock/downgrade permission.
Execute only that bounded approved route, capture attributable entry/first checkpoint and failure/timeout context.
Stop on missing checkpoint, unsafe state or failure-return uncertainty; publish sanitized evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Exact installed route applicability and observed bounded entry/exit are demonstrated on the candidate; compilation or command names do not pass.
conditions: Admission decision outcome must be GO; a closed NO-GO issue does not unblock this task.
Pretrial recovery/log provisions are reviewed in the admission package; #346/#348 stay open until actual runtime evidence.

tasks.name: Independent stock return and failed-load recovery
tasks.goal: Prove recovery is reachable independently of the failed experimental system.
steps: Use the approved exact route and capture; do not repeat already-proven normal stock return.
Demonstrate the approved failure/timeout return case without depending on a healthy experimental OS.
Verify exact stock operation and enumerate uncovered security/retention state.
tasks.acceptance: Independent return after the approved failed-load case and stock restoration are observed with exact revisions/logs; ordinary stock return alone fails.
tasks.closed_issue_evidence_boundary: Issue is closed completed and board Done. Ordinary stock return is observed; closure alone does not qualify failed-experiment return. Remaining phase344/release failure-return acceptance stays explicit until tested.

tasks.name: Failed-boot log retention — normal log capture complete
tasks.goal: Obtain attributable experimental boot/failure logs through the approved channel.
steps: Validate freshness/build identity and beginning/end/timeout context.
Retrieve the actual diagnostic/failure log, record cap/loss/retention behavior and checkpoint coverage.
Keep raw logs private and publish sanitized provenance; distinguish existing320KiB stock export.
tasks.acceptance: Real candidate boot/failure log and retrieval/retention coverage are demonstrated. A fixed host frame, source config or stock archive alone fails.
tasks.completed_milestone: TWRP recovery log22493B/current kernel log130931B retrieved in PR452; see approved-lab-entry/runtime-result.json. Prior320KiB stock export is separate.
tasks.remaining_acceptance: Fresh attributable failed-experiment log retention and retrieval remain unqualified; do not repeat normal capture as unfinished work.

tasks.name: Diagnostic memory/UART and internal storage
tasks.goal: Boot the minimal diagnostic candidate with usable memory and internal storage evidence.
steps: Verify actual RAM/reservations and UART/log integration from the admitted attempt.
Identify MMC/pinctrl/power/IRQ contracts and safe storage geometry.
Start with approved read-only integrity checks; use disposable user-data files only under the approved test scope.
Record checksums, errors and exact build; never treat firmware/security partition writes as routine storage smoke.
tasks.acceptance: On-device memory/log integration and internal-storage integrity pass without corruption or unexplained faults.

tasks.name: Clock/reset provider qualification
tasks.goal: Qualify the provider behavior needed by the integrated board.
steps: Reuse accepted source/build work and completed audio-parent scope#29.
Compare actual candidate provider rates/parents/reset ownership with the reviewed contract.
Make only the active blocker fix; check exact build and approved device behavior.
tasks.acceptance: Required clock/reset providers and ownership/rates are observed on-device; source compilation alone fails.

tasks.name: Pinctrl and EINT qualification
tasks.goal: Qualify pin mux, bias, IRQ and GPIO ownership before dependent input devices.
steps: Resolve exact controller/IRQ/source mappings including the retained GPIO87 question.
Integrate only source-backed pin/reset/power settings; no blind probing or electrical actions.
Exercise approved interrupt/input paths with actual logs.
tasks.acceptance: Required pinctrl/EINT behavior is measured on-device with no lost interrupts or unsafe ownership changes.

tasks.name: PMIC wrapper and power-domain qualification
tasks.goal: Qualify supply/domain behavior and safe MMIO ownership.
steps: Reuse accepted pwrap/scpsys/SYM source work; preserve explicit bank/voltage/clock-order unknowns.
Review only the active candidate domain/clock/supply sequence.
Perform only approved bounded runtime checks; high-risk voltage/security/electrical actions need explicit approval.
tasks.acceptance: Required supplies/domains and safe access/order pass on-device; no thermal/data-loss or unqualified voltage handoff is hidden.

tasks.name: Display and backlight
tasks.goal: Make the actual panel usable through its identified controller/PHY/backlight path.
steps: Identify exact panel and source-backed init/power/reset/clock sequence; no copied unknown panel data.
Integrate DSI/MIPI/MMSYS/composition dependencies and the bounded PWM source policy as needed.
Build the exact candidate, then test panel output/orientation and approved brightness limits.
tasks.acceptance: Correct stable panel image and brightness endpoints plus wake/resume are measured on-device; no blank/corrupt/unsafe output.

tasks.name: Touch and input
tasks.goal: Make identified touch hardware and coordinates reliable.
steps: Identify exact touch-controller variant, bus, power/reset/IRQ and board orientation.
Integrate kernel/DT/input configuration against the qualified pinctrl/EINT contract.
Test a non-sensitive grid, edges, declared contacts and wake behavior.
tasks.acceptance: All screen areas and touch coordinates/contacts work on-device without dead regions, stuck input or wake loss.

tasks.name: GPU and Android graphics composition
tasks.goal: Qualify the declared renderer/GPU/composer path.
steps: Identify exact GPU/kernel/userspace/Mesa/HAL and memory/IOMMU requirements.
Integrate one coherent graphics stack with explicit supported APIs and limitations.
Measure UI/composition/render behavior; software rendering is not hardware acceleration proof.
tasks.acceptance: On-device rendering/composition and declared API/stability tests pass; any unsupported acceleration requires an explicit owner scope decision, not a hardware pass.

tasks.name: Reproducible integrated Android candidate
tasks.goal: Build and boot a stable, supported, updated and reproducible Android platform with the ValethonOS identity.
steps: Select the supported Android/upstream release target and pin actual security patch/component versions and reproducible update/maintenance path; do not equate a new build date with current security fixes.
Pin complete source/ABI/Binder/config/firmware/HAL/package inputs and licensing needs.
Reproduce the integrated candidate and artifact manifest.
Boot through setup/home UI with SELinux enforcing and approved security configuration; exercise settings/app lifecycle.

Implement ValethonOS branding in boot animation, setup identity, wallpaper, launcher defaults and About/build information; preserve upstream attribution, license notices and accurate Android/security-patch fields.

Validate repeated normal boot, settings/app lifecycle and release stability using exact candidate evidence; resolve encryption/device-policy and enforcing-security requirements before claiming readiness.
tasks.acceptance: Exact reproducible supported/updated Android candidate boots to usable UI, passes recorded stability and enforcing-security requirements, has a verified update path and ValethonOS branding with accurate upstream/security attribution. Interim LineageOS18.1 boot or branding alone does not pass; Connect/feature QA remains deferred.

tasks.name: Wi-Fi integration and reconnect qualification
tasks.goal: Qualify actual wireless chip/firmware/kernel/HAL and network behavior.
steps: Identify exact wireless module and source/firmware/proprietary interface compatibility.
Integrate one network path and build the exact candidate without security bypasses.
Use an authorized test network for integrity transfer, three reconnects and wake-cycle checks.
tasks.acceptance: On-device authorized Wi-Fi connectivity, transfer integrity and reconnect behavior pass with private credentials/logs protected.

tasks.name: Audio playback and recording
tasks.goal: Qualify actual AFE/codec/routes and Android audio integration.
steps: Resolve the unmatched AFE source/codec/clock/reset contract; source AUDSYS clocks are not audio functionality.
Integrate kernel and Android audio HAL/policy for identified routes.
Test non-sensitive playback/recording, volume/mute and resume on declared routes.
tasks.acceptance: On-device playback/recording and route/volume/wake behavior pass with exact logs and no persistent underrun or route loss.

tasks.name: Charging, battery and thermal qualification
tasks.goal: Qualify safe battery/charging reporting and model-specific thermal behavior.
steps: Resolve exact sensor/calibration/bank/conversion/supply contracts; no guessed MT8173 thermal alias.
Integrate only source-backed battery/charger/thermal policy.
Use approved measurement methods and model-qualified limits; never invent thresholds or weaken protections.
tasks.acceptance: On-device battery/charging/thermal observations agree with approved measurement and limits; unknown safe limits block sustained tests.

tasks.name: Suspend and wake
tasks.goal: Qualify wake sources, domain/clock order and Android power behavior.
steps: Resolve the active wake/PMIC/domain/clock-policy blocker only.
Build the candidate retaining qualified charging/thermal behavior.
Run ten approved screen-off/suspend/wake cycles and inspect state/retention.
tasks.acceptance: Ten on-device cycles pass without reboot, wake loop, storage corruption or persistent input/network/audio loss.

tasks.name: USB transport and integrity
tasks.goal: Qualify declared USB roles and usable diagnostic/data transport.
steps: Identify actual port0/controller/PHY/role/security dependencies; port1 is not assumed supported.
Integrate the declared role/profile with approved userspace policy and no security weakening.
Test enumeration, approved data/log transfer, disconnect/reconnect and return behavior.
tasks.acceptance: Declared on-device USB roles and integrity/cleanup pass; bytes queued by gadget writes are not host receipt or boot proof.

tasks.name: SD integrity and hotplug
tasks.goal: Qualify the identified SD host/pins/power/volume path.
steps: Review exact controller/pinctrl/IRQ/voltage/timing support.
Integrate the supported mode and Android volume behavior.
Use a disposable authorized card for checksummed read/write, clean unmount and three hotplug cycles.
tasks.acceptance: On-device SD integrity/hotplug passes with declared capacities/modes and no corruption.

tasks.name: Video decode and playback
tasks.goal: Qualify the declared codec/decoder and Android media path.
steps: Identify codec block/firmware/memory/Codec2 dependencies and acceleration limits.
Integrate the selected media path with licensing and source obligations recorded.
Play approved local clips covering declared formats/resolutions; inspect seek, sync, frame delivery and thermal behavior.
tasks.acceptance: On-device declared video playback tests pass; actual acceleration versus software decode and unsupported modes are explicit.

tasks.name: Bluetooth integration and qualification
tasks.goal: Qualify the exact controller/firmware/transport/HAL.
steps: Identify exact controller and Android interface/firmware contract.
Integrate only the selected source/config/transport.
Pair an authorized device; exercise a declared profile, three reconnects and a wake cycle.
tasks.acceptance: On-device Bluetooth pairing/profile/reconnect tests pass; unsupported profiles are explicit.

tasks.name: Sensors integration and qualification
tasks.goal: Qualify identified sensor chips and Android events.
steps: Identify actual buses/IRQs/orientation/ranges and permissions.
Integrate only identified kernel/HAL paths.
Test each declared sensor using bounded known stimuli and wake/event checks.
tasks.acceptance: On-device sensor identity/orientation/range/event delivery pass for the declared list; unsupported sensors remain unqualified.

tasks.name: Front/rear camera qualification
tasks.goal: Qualify actual sensors, ISP and Android camera integration.
steps: Identify each sensor/bus/clock/reset/power/ISP/HAL dependency.
Implement only reviewed source-backed sequences; no guessed voltage/power writes.
Capture non-sensitive frames and preview/video on each declared camera, including open/close and wake.
tasks.acceptance: On-device declared camera modes/orientation/capture tests pass; an explicit deferral never becomes a hardware pass.

tasks.name: Final candidate DT binding and dependency validation
tasks.goal: Validate the integrated candidate rather than chase unrelated bindings before first boot.
steps: Reuse accepted source-matched controls; no new standalone peripheral scope without its ordered task.
Validate the exact candidate full corpus and fresh source graph, preserving diagnostic identities/unsupported scope.
Resolve candidate-required failures through their owning subsystem issues; do not suppress or fake bindings.
tasks.acceptance: The exact beta candidate meets its approved DT/dependency gate; full failure counts, unsupported nodes and any exclusions stay explicit.

tasks.name: Owner first-party license decision
tasks.goal: Record the actual owner licensing decision for first-party deliverables.
steps: Present the exact license/ownership decision and implications.
Record the explicit owner decision without assuming it.
tasks.acceptance: Owner decision and affected first-party scope are recorded; this is separate from third-party redistribution.

tasks.name: Distribution and source obligations
tasks.goal: Resolve obligations for the exact candidate artifact set.
steps: Inventory kernel/Android/firmware/HAL/app components and licenses.
Verify source notices/provisioning/redistribution restrictions and GMS/package feasibility.
Remove or hold artifacts lacking permission; record the supported distribution scope.
Verify project branding and retained upstream notices against the exact public artifact/source set; distinguish first-party identity from bundled upstream and proprietary components.
tasks.acceptance: The exact deliverable has a documented lawful distribution/source-notice plan; unresolved paid/proprietary access is not silently assumed.

tasks.name: Exact beta package and recovery handoff
tasks.goal: Assemble a candidate whose install/restore/log procedure matches the evidence.
steps: Pin all artifact/config/source hashes, device support, known defects and limitations.
Include reviewed installation/return/recovery/log instructions with exact risk/approval boundaries.
Check all mandatory roadmap gates and actual results against the beta matrix.
Package the stable updated ValethonOS-branded OS with version/security-patch/update-channel information, source/notices and known limitations; distinguish it from the interim LineageOS lab baseline.
tasks.acceptance: Exact coherent beta package and recoverable handoff are reviewable; generic Image or source-only receipts do not pass. Public handoff includes truthful project branding, exact supported version/security patch and a tested update path; unsupported or unresolved mandatory security gates remain unpassed.

tasks.name: Beta admission review
tasks.goal: Admit owner QA only after actual prerequisites pass.
steps: Review exact package and the A01–A07 admission matrix.
Confirm no unresolved critical recovery, data-loss, thermal or security failure.
Record Go/No-go and the supported/unsupported list; never close an untested runtime gate.
Confirm stable, updated platform release readiness before admitting Connect, passkey or other feature QA; do not install app QA candidates merely because the interim ROM boots.
tasks.acceptance: Owner QA admission is based on measured candidate evidence and an approved handoff, not task/PR counts. Connect and feature QA start only after the stable updated platform release meets the recorded platform admission gates.

selection_source: Live GitHub issue/project state and explicit outcome gates; never infer readiness from this static plan alone.

release_requirements.interim_baseline: Existing LineageOS18.1 Android11 build is an installed hardware/entry baseline, not the finished project OS.
release_requirements.up_to_date_definition: Select and record the supported Android/upstream target, actual security patch level, component versions and reproducible update path. A recent build date alone is not evidence of current security maintenance.
release_requirements.branding_constraints: Use the ValethonOS identity with owner-approved names/assets; preserve upstream attribution/license notices and truthful Android/security-patch information. Branding alone does not satisfy platform acceptance.
release_requirements.connect_and_passkey_qa: Deferred until the stable updated platform release and exact QA admission gates pass.

phase_progress_presentation.view: Phase gates — progress and next steps
visible_summary: Latest result: measured milestones already achieved
Current work: active task/PR or clearly queued/history/complete
Next action: specific next operation or handoff
Blocker: actual remaining dependency, not resolved approval/host waits
